metadata.description: Portable agent skills for any Agent Skills-compatible runtime

plugins.name: skills4sh
plugins.description: Agent skills: agent-memory (cross-agent persistent project memory), discord-harvest (bot-authorized and user-exported Discord content archival), eleventy-nunjucks (11ty + Nunjucks conventions), init-rulebook (personal agent rulebook setup and loading), localhost-screenshots (responsive screenshot capture), skill-architect (open-spec portable skill authoring/review rubric with adapters and eval planning)
